Kenney "Casino Audio" (www.kenney.nl)
  coins.mp3         <- chips-stack-3.ogg

"Air Woosh Move" by Almitory, OpenGameArt.org (https://opengameart.org/content/air-woosh-move)
  depart.mp3        <- air_move.wav (trimmed to 1.2 s with a fade-out)

Converted to mono 96 kbps MP3 with leading silence trimmed.

Kenney "Music Jingles" (www.kenney.nl)
  arrival.mp3       <- jingles_STEEL10.ogg (steel drum, rising D-E-F#-G)

More interface sounds (CC0, www.kenney.nl, Interface Sounds)
